body.title: Host: the pending list and its messages
body.summary: chat-panel.ts, behind the optional `attachments` seams on ChatPanelHostDeps: a per-session pending list in host memory; attach-image (size checked from the base64 length before decoding, then addBytes), pick-attachments (pickFiles then addFile for each, up to the remaining room), remove-attachment and open-attachment (ids resolved against the active session's pending list and rows, never a path from the message); adds serialized per session; attachments-pending posted after every add, remove and pick and with the session state on ready, new-chat and open-chat; refusals and failures posted as one error sentence. Without the seams the four messages are ignored.
acceptanceChecks: attach-image and pick-attachments add to the active session's pending list and post attachments-pending; remove-attachment removes one
An attach-image whose base64 length implies more than the limit is refused without decoding and without calling the store
A refusal or a failing write or dialog posts one error sentence and leaves the list unchanged; a dismissed dialog posts nothing; over the limit the first ten are kept
ready, new-chat and open-chat post each session's own pending list
An unknown or foreign id in remove or open does nothing; open-attachment opens the resolved path of a row's or a pending attachment
Without the seams the four messages are ignored and nothing is posted

tests.name: host: attach-image and pick-attachments add to the active session's pending list and post attachments-pending; remove-attachment removes one; errors are posted as one sentence and the list is unchanged

host: ready, new-chat and open-chat post each session's own pending list; an unknown or foreign attachment id in remove or open does nothing; open-attachment opens the resolved path of a row's or a pending attachment
host without the attachments seams: the shell has no attach button or chip row and the four messages are ignored
host: an attach-image whose base64 length implies more than the limit is refused without decoding and without calling the store
host: a dismissed dialog posts nothing, and a pick over the limit keeps the first ten and posts one error sentence
